events.text:
T-052 is built, deployed to the centre Worker with the Tantra push off, and blocked only on the Tantra API key already tracked on T-234/T-337.

- **Build:** `pushToCampaign` imports an attendee into the pre campaign on sign-up and into the post campaign when Day 3 ends. A new per-attendee ledger table (migration 0022) stops anyone being pushed twice. The admin has new fields for the campaign ids and offer links, and the setup spec is in `workshop-plan/sequences/campaign-setup.md`.
- **Pre-campaign scope:** I left the confirmation, day-before and one-hour messages to the T-234 reminder campaigns. The pre campaign carries the "what to prepare" message, and a separate "Pre-workshop: VIP upgrade" campaign covers the free lane.
- **Checked:** the new simulator probe `app/scripts/probe-nurture.mjs` passes. It covers the sign-up import, the Day 3 import, no duplicates, and no n8n, Instantly, SendGrid or Twilio. The existing reminders probe still passes.
- **Shipped:** migration 0022 is applied remotely, the Worker is deployed, and the commit is pushed to main. The live admin endpoint shows nurture off and no key saved.
- **Not done:** I haven't created the real campaigns or run the live [email] test, because there is no Tantra key yet. The Tantra step delay (days between messages) is unconfirmed against live Tantra, so the first live run needs to check the post sequence spacing.

The task is now `blocked`, with reviewers Aquila and Bharath. I acked F-77b1c371.
